Our Partners

In Partnership with NeuroSphere Global

NeuroSphere Global is a comprehensive neuro rehabilitation and brain health practice dedicated to helping individuals maximise function, independence, and quality of life across the lifespan.

Founded by Jayshree Nagvekar (Occupational Therapist, Dementia Practitioner & Stroke Rehabilitation Specialist) and Disha Maniyar (Occupational Therapist with a Fellowship in Geriatric Rehabilitation and special interest in brain health and healthy ageing), NeuroSphere provides comprehensive services for individuals living with neurological, developmental, and age-related conditions.

Areas of expertise include stroke rehabilitation, Parkinson's disease, dementia and memory care, cognitive rehabilitation, paediatric developmental support, brain health, healthy ageing, caregiver education, and functional recovery.

Together, ARC Clinic and NeuroSphere Global are committed to delivering accessible, high-quality rehabilitation services that empower individuals to live fuller, healthier, and more independent lives.

Arc Clinic

A holistic wellness centre in Four Bungalows, Andheri West, Mumbai. Physiotherapy, Pilates, Nutrition, Neuro Rehabilitation and Lifestyle Medicine under one roof.
